entities.summary: Joanna Mihułka-Petru formerly Joanna Schmidt is a Polish manager, politician and economist. She was a member of the Sejm from 2015 to 2019, representing the Modern party. Since 2024, she is the wife of the parties' founder Ryszard Petru.
